description: Create an origin-locked site key for frontend JavaScript. Site keys are restricted to specific origins and endpoints, safe to embed in public code.

allowed_endpoints.description: API endpoints this key can call (e.g., ['/query', '/insert-record', '/report']). Security-sensitive endpoints like /export, /import, /compile are always denied.

allowed_origins.description: HTTPS scheme+host patterns where this key works (e.g., ['https://chaprola.org'] or ['https://example.com']). Browser Origin headers are always scheme+host only — path patterns like 'https://chaprola.org/apps/poll/*' are rejected because they can never match a real browser request. Trailing '*' wildcard on the host is allowed (e.g., 'https://example.com*').

name: chaprola_create_site_key
